annotation.title_clean: ILIA 2025: Consolidated as a Policy-Design Instrument for Artificial Intelligence in the Region
annotation.title_en: ILIA 2025: Consolidated as a Policy-Design Instrument for Artificial Intelligence in the Region
annotation.authors_or_issuer: ECLAC (UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean)
annotation.summary_en: ECLAC briefing note on the third Latin American AI Index (ILIA 2025), assessing AI preparedness, adoption and governance in 19 countries. It reports uneven maturity, talent and investment gaps, and weak financing of national AI strategies. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Chile, Brazil and Uruguay classified as pioneers; over one-third of countries are explorers
Region attracts only 1.12% of global AI investment despite 6.6% of global GDP
National AI strategies often lack financing, implementation and evaluation mechanisms
Regulatory approaches focus on risk management rather than building innovation ecosystems
Few policies incorporate gender or environmental perspectives
